Name: Tiger Tiger Burning Bright - New Barn Animal
Author: WillOhTheWisp
Description:
[left][b][font=Georgia][size=2][img]https://imgur.com/ntrQaXg.png[/img]﻿[/size][/font][/b][/left][font=Georgia][size=2]
Tyger Tyger, burning bright,
In the forests of the night;
What immortal hand or eye,
Could frame thy fearful symmetry?

[spoiler]In what distant deeps or skies.
Burnt the fire of thine eyes?
On what wings dare he aspire?
What the hand, dare seize the fire?

And what shoulder, & what art,
Could twist the sinews of thy heart?
And when thy heart began to beat.
What dread hand? & what dread feet?

What the hammer? what the chain,
In what furnace was thy brain?
What the anvil? what dread grasp.
Dare its deadly terrors clasp?

When the stars threw down their spears
And water'd heaven with their tears:
Did he smile his work to see?
Did he who made the Lamb make thee?

Tyger Tyger burning bright,
In the forests of the night:
What immortal hand or eye,
Dare frame thy fearful symmetry?

-The Tyger by William Blake[/spoiler]
[img]https://imgur.com/SiCPsKg.png[/img]

Adds tigers as new barn animals. There are three coat varieties - orange, golden, and white. The tigers will mature in 10 days. They will bring you mahogany seeds every few days. Once you've reached 100 friendship, they'll let you gather some of their shed whiskers, 3 of which can be recycled into 1 curiosity lure. Once you've reached 200 friendship, they'll bring you tiger slime eggs!

I'm learning as I go, so only time will tell if my ambitions are too grand. I am planning to explore features from Extra Animal Configs to expand the tiger behaviors even more. The more I learn the more I'll try to add. Stay tuned![/size][/font]
